description: Registry of C-Box norm profiles. Each entry points to a SHACL shapes file that binds to a dhc:Norm instance in the T-Box. Scoped to France while the v3 core is prototyped — DIN VDE 0100 (DE), AREI/RGIE (BE) and BS 7671 (GB) were removed in v3.0.0 and are re-added once dhc-core is released. Every profile listed here must bind to a dhc:Norm that exists in the T-Box; tests/cbox/manifest.test.js enforces that.
